source.title: Answering Fire's Call
source.description:
You strong. Strong enough.

<The elemental sparks and flickers.>

Elements of Feralas. Essence. Find Shrine.

Take Fragment. Will help.
source.objective:
Collect 3 Elemental Essence from the water elementals on The Forgotten Coast across from Sardor Isle in Feralas and combine them with the Fragment of Fire to summon help at the corrupted shrine there.

Provided item:
source.completion: Need help. Other elements strong. Bring them.
